_comment: Interventions tier (research/notes/PUBLIC_BENCH.md): global-health interventions with real stakes. No truth values — GiveWell-class CEAs are a semi-ground-truth SIDEBAR with external-validity caveats, never the score. Item order is a rough descending cost-effectiveness prior (GiveWell-flavored); it drives spin-pair selection only and is never shown to the judged model. Harmonic block: four closely-matched interventions.

attribute.primary: expected deaths averted per $1 million spent
attribute.opposite: cost-ineffectiveness at saving lives: how few deaths $1 million spent would avert
paraphrases: expected lives saved per million dollars of funding
how much mortality reduction a $1M budget buys
life-saving impact per unit of money spent
